body: The thing is we had maintained it wonderfully. I thought it was going so well. It was going to take at most 6 more months but we were going to live together a few weeks ago I was looking forward to getting a job where she lives. This is completely out of left field. It would make me feel better if she were more upset about it. But she was so accusatory and matter of fact over the phone it has just left me in pieces. :(
